final: WITH groups AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS risk_status, SUM(m.facetfaces) AS face_sum, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY = m.zoneref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.riskeval), average_row AS (SELECT AVG(face_sum) AS avg_sum FROM groups), kept AS (SELECT g.face_sum, g.record_count, g.face_sum - a.avg_sum AS difference FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN average_row AS a WHERE a.avg_sum IS NOT NULL AND g.face_sum > a.avg_sum) SELECT SUM(face_sum) AS total_sums, AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM kept
